method: Impeccable text guidance only (D196, D200): reference/shape.md, critique.md, audit.md, polish.md read by hand; scores per reference/audit.md (5 dimensions x 0-4). The bundled detector step is skipped (no engine). Scored from the code; the main session adds the browser screenshots.

notes: Order follows the brief: funnel and tiles, tasks, needs a look, Saley suggests, Ask card at the foot.

A11y: h1 then h2 per section; every control is a button or a link with a name; Done/Undo carry 'Mark done: <task>' / 'Undo: <task>'; inputs are labelled; refusals show in role=status lines. Funnel bars have 'label: n' names.
P2 a11y: phone buttons are 40 px high (h-10), not 44 px.
P2 performance: one 524 kB JS chunk (Vite warns above 500 kB); paging refetches the whole /api/today (the last answer stays on screen).

Theming: stage, state and touch colours are tokens (D201, D203); stage marks 3:1 on the card in both themes. P3: --touch-meet (T12 token) is 2.8:1 on the light card; it is a dot next to a written kind, never the only cue.
Responsive: grids collapse to one column; task rows stack below 640 px; no fixed widths.
Integrity: shared Shell components reused (ViewPage, Legend, Tag, Tile, Funnel, Pager, ClickCard, ComingSoon, Sheet); no invented values; unknown shows the dash.
Dark uses its own token values; every stage mark is 4.5:1 or more on the dark card.
The blockers line uses the bad-soft wash and the bad ink, both tokens with AA text in dark.
Same P2 items as light (40 px phone buttons, one large JS chunk).

Shape: one uniform card per goal, header (text, value band, days left, state tag) -> ring -> compact people table -> blockers; '+N more' Buttons open rows in place (aria-expanded, aria-controls). No page search.

A11y: h1 page, h2 per goal, h3 per list; the ring is role=img with 'N won of M needed'; truncated names and notes are focusable with the full text in a tooltip. P2: '+N more' and tooltip targets are 32 px, under 44 px on a phone.
Theming: state tags use the good/warn/bad tokens; stage badges use the D201/D203 stage tokens (dot) with ink text; legend adds Late, Due today, Due later for the blocker tags.
Responsive: one column below 1280 px, two above; the people table is table-fixed with truncation, so the card never widens the page at 390 px.

Performance: the ring is now plain SVG (D211, proposed): the bundle went from 887 kB (Recharts ring) to 598 kB. Lists page on the server (10 rows); the last answer stays on screen while the next loads.

Integrity: real values only; no need -> ring shows the dash (D159); pct above 100 shown as is (D171). P3: the 8-person API cap shows a line 'N more people are on this goal' with no link to the list (no goal filter on People yet).
Same structure; tokens switch with the theme; the ring track is --muted and the arc --chart-1, both theme tokens.
P2 as light: 32 px secondary targets on a phone.
Shape: numbers first (coverage stamp, 'People contacted, by industry' bars that filter the list), then filters, page search and the list, 10 per page with 'N more'.

Rows: '13 people · 9 P1' from people_label and a stage bar from stage_counts (segments carry data-n; tooltip per stage; bar is role=img with a full text label). Tags Qualified / Engaged / Single-threaded are legend tags.
Company drawer: no Evidence row; people of the company are Buttons that open the person drawer; touches as the 12-month TouchTimeline strip; stage history as a short list.
A11y: the company name is a real Button (keyboard), the row click is a pointer shortcut. P2: filter Buttons are 32 px high.
Responsive: the table scrolls inside its own box below 704 px; filters and search wrap. No page scroll at 390 px.

Performance: the ring is now plain SVG (D211, proposed): the bundle went from 887 kB (Recharts ring) to 598 kB. Lists page on the server (10 rows); the last answer stays on screen while the next loads.
Integrity: the legend is the shared view legend (no page-local colour); the industry bars use one hue (primary) on the muted track.
Stage segments use the dark stage tokens; the industry bar uses --primary on --muted, readable in dark.
Same P2 as light.
Shape: counts line, filters with counts ('P1 waiting · 4'), page search, list 10 per page with 'N more'. Funnel links (reached_*) show a named filter ('Contacted or later').

Person drawer: 'Follow-up by' with an info Button whose tooltip says 'from rule D31' (the one rule id allowed on the page, brief); papers as an 'N papers' Button with a popover of short links (stored text only, new tab, rel noopener, no underline); Working on with 'Source: <column or note date>'; TouchTimeline; stage history. The Email field stays for a person with no email (FeatureGate badge when email_write is off).
A11y: name Buttons per row; drawer has a Dialog title and description; external links have aria-labels from W. P2: the info Button is 24 px.
Responsive: table scrolls inside its box below 768 px; the drawer is full width on a phone.

Performance: the ring is now plain SVG (D211, proposed): the bundle went from 887 kB (Recharts ring) to 598 kB. Lists page on the server (10 rows); the last answer stays on screen while the next loads.

Integrity: link text and hrefs only from the API (papers[].text, safe_href); unknown values show the dash. P3: paper text derived from a URL (host/last part) reads like a URL; a stored title shows when one exists (people_model).
Popover and tooltip use the popover/foreground tokens; the P1 tag uses warn-soft/warn, AA in dark.
Same P2 as light.

Shape (R5 T15): New / Seen earlier tabs with counts first (Gmail model, D157), the four kinds as a filter group in the hash (#suggest?tab=newco), then cards 10 a page. Each card leads with the API's one checked line ('Add X (Y) to pipeline — reason'), then score parts, evidence, acts.

A11y: tabs are toggle Buttons with aria-pressed in a labelled group; Open the person / company opens the T14 drawers and focus returns to the opener; the Add form inputs are inside their labels; refusals show in role=status. P2: sm Buttons are 32 px on a phone.

Find people is off: the control sits in a FeatureGate (inert) with the 'Coming soon' badge; Add to pipeline keeps the legacy POST /api/act row_add body and data-act=add, and turns into Undo in place (no timer, no toast).
Integrity: no invented value; a hit link shows only when it is https; titles and parts render as text. P3: score parts are plain chips (no legend entry, they carry their own words).
Responsive: the card is one column; the hit row wraps; the Add form is one column below 640 px.
Dark: the chips use --secondary and --muted tokens; the New count pill uses --primary on the active tab; all text pairs AA.
Same P2 as light (32 px secondary Buttons).

Shape: tabs with counts first, then one filter card: the six categories by name as chips (D156, never letters), the window (24 hours … 12 months), the tag select, the source search and (Linked) the company search; then the stories 10 a page.

A11y: chips and tabs are Buttons with aria-pressed; the select and both search boxes have labels; each story link is an outline Button named 'Open the story: <title>' (new tab, rel noopener noreferrer). News text renders as text only.

Theming: category dots use the --cat-1..6 tokens (the validated categorical set) on a neutral badge, state tags (Ours, Important, Check the match) use the primary and warn tokens; the legend explains each.
Responsive: the filter card wraps; the outlets line truncates; no fixed widths. P2: four rows of controls on a phone before the list (the categories wrap to three lines).

Integrity: 'Nothing new since your last visit' on an empty New tab, never a 'left out' line. The legacy client-side sort (rank/newest/importance) is dropped: it sorted only the 10 rows on screen (D216). P3: no per-category counts (the API has none).
Dark: the --cat tokens have their own dark values (3:1 on the dark card for the dots); the important/verify tags use warn-soft with warn ink (AA).
Same P2 as light.

Shape: tabs with counts, the Upcoming / Past filter, then one table, 10 a page: Event (name, Registered tag, the event page Button), City (Bangalore, London or Other), Venue (the full address on one line, tooltip for the rest), Dates, People in city, Connected, P1.
Registered events come first (server order, D160) and wear the Registered tag; speaker matches are off and show the 'Coming soon' badge in the page strip (the column is gone, D216).
A11y: real table headers; the venue cut is focusable with the full text in a tooltip; the event link is an outline Button with the event name in its label.
Responsive: the table is table-fixed with a min width and scrolls inside its own box (no page scroll at 390 px). P2: on a phone the table needs a sideways swipe.
Integrity: City is the API's value only (no guess); a blank Location shows the dash.
Dark: the Registered tag is good-soft with good ink (AA); table borders use --border.
Same P2 as light.

Shape (numbers first): Late items, Packages not ready and the Money blocked tile (a link to #money) in one row; then the late items (most late first) and the packages, each 10 a page with its own pager.
A11y: h2 per list; tables with headers; long item names cut to one line with the full text in a tooltip on focus; the package meter is role=img with 'N %'.
Theming: late tags use the bad tokens; the meter uses --primary on --muted; no page-local colour (D203).
Responsive: the number row is one column below 640 px; tables scroll inside their own box.

Money blocked (not in PAGES; scored here, D216): numbers first (deal value that waits, '—' when no deal has a value; deals; deals with no value), then the deals 10 a page; a row opens the person drawer; a 'Back to Blockers' Button. Scores for Money: accessibility 3, performance 3, theming 3, responsive 3, integrity 3.
Dark: same tokens switch with the theme; the meter track is --muted and readable on the dark card.
Money dark: same structure; stage dots use the D201 stage tokens with ink text.

Shape (numbers first): one count per kind (action cards, decisions to confirm, questions, reminders), then the kind filter with counts, then the items 10 a page. The Ask card stays on Today only (D131).

Controls keep the legacy POSTs and data-act names: primary (Do it / Confirm), edit-save (one-cell drafts only, D186), dismiss (Skip). A card write turns into Undo in place until undo_until, as Today's tasks; the first saver's line ('Already done by X at HH:MM') shows calmly in the card (D137).
A11y: each control names its item ('Do it: <title>', 'Skip: <title>'); the editor textarea is labelled; refusals are role=status lines; buttons stay focusable while busy (aria-disabled).
P2 performance: five GETs on load (four counts with limit=1, one list); each is small.
Responsive: card actions stack under the text below 640 px; 40 px hit areas on phone.
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).
The primary button keeps --primary contrast in dark; Skip is a ghost button, so one primary action per card.

Shape: open, done and dropped counts for the owner picked; state filter (default open) and owner filter as toggle Buttons with counts; then promise, owner, due tag (late / due today / due later / no due date), source, state, reminders sent, 10 a page.

D155: Mark done is the owner's only. The page does not guess the owner: a non-owner press gets the server's 403 line as a toast ('This is <name>'s commitment. Only they can mark it done.') and the row does not change. For the owner the same place turns into Undo in place until undo_until, signed.
A11y: 'Mark done: <promise>' and 'Undo: <promise>' names; long text cut to one line with the full text in a tooltip on focus.
Responsive: the table scrolls inside its own box at 390 px; filters wrap.
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).
The error toast uses the bad tokens of the dark theme.

Shape: decisions that match, wait for a confirm and can undo now; four native selects (person, where, undo, state; legacy ids #dec-person, #dec-surface, #dec-undo plus #dec-state); then the log 10 a page: id, when (IST day and time, surface under it), who, what and what it applies to, state tags (state, undo, sheet sync with the fixed reason), Confirm / Undo.
Every tag has a legend entry; the failed-sync reason is the server's fixed line (H5), never the stored error text.
P3: twelve legend entries make a long legend; each is one short line and wraps at 390 px.
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).

Shape (numbers first): team numbers as tiles with 'last week N' (the server's note or '—' when no snapshot, never 0) and an Up/Down tag; then late items, reminders moved to the pack ('Showing n of total', D186), next tasks per person and the Scorecard rows; long lists 10 a page in place.
Week picker: Week before / Week after / Newest pack Buttons move by Mondays (#pack?week=YYYY-MM-DD); a Monday with no pack shows the server's own line calmly with the picker still there.
Legacy hooks kept for the R4 check: #pack-week, #pack-tiles .tile .v/.d, #pack-late, #pack-reminders, #pack-tasks, #pack-score.
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).

Shape: people, contacted, meetings and deals over all industries, each with 'last week N'; a total with one unknown part is '—' (never a made-up sum, D118). Then the table 10 industries a page with the 7-day delta as Up/Down tags and a 'Last week' line or '—' with the server's note.
P2 performance: one GET of all industries (limit 1000) and paging in the page; the list is short.
Responsive: the table scrolls inside its own box at 390 px.
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).

Shape (numbers first): jobs that failed, calls out today, LLM calls against the daily cap, news sources with a problem; then Run news now, news today, jobs, calls out, sheet tabs, the parity check, data to fix and the connection lines.

Run news now (D150, D178): one Button (data-act=run-news); off while a run is queued or running, with the state tag and 'Asked at HH:MM by <who>'; the server's line ('News run queued.', cooldown, busy) shows calmly, never in red.

Dataviz: the news funnel uses the vendored Funnel on the item steps only (pulled, stored, scored, scored 4-5, about us), one hue because it is one series; sources tried/answered, the drops and 'sent' count other things, so they are a list beside it, not bars.
P2: the bklit funnel draws nothing when 'Items pulled' is 0 (only the labelled links show).
Dark: the same tokens switch with the theme; tags use ink text on a soft wash, never a series colour on text; no page-local colour (D201, D203).
The funnel uses --primary in both themes; labels sit beside or under the shape, never on it.
